parameters.query:
SELECT s.*
FROM user_schedules s
INNER JOIN "User_UC_Mappings" um ON um.user_id = s.user_id AND um.active = true
INNER JOIN feedback_config_rules f ON f.id = um.feedback_config_rule_id
WHERE f.usecase_id = $1
  AND ($2::int IS NULL OR s.user_id = $2)
ORDER BY s.schedule_id;

UPDATE user_schedules
SET interval_days = $2,
    measure_type = $3,
    trigger_percentage = $4,
    user_id = $5,
    next_run_date = COALESCE($6::date, next_run_date)
WHERE schedule_id = $1
RETURNING schedule_id, user_id, interval_days, next_run_date, measure_type, trigger_percentage, active;

UPDATE user_schedules s
SET active = false
WHERE s.schedule_id = $1
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "User_UC_Mappings" um
    JOIN feedback_config_rules f ON f.id = um.feedback_config_rule_id
    WHERE um.user_id = s.user_id
      AND um.active = true
      AND f.usecase_id = $2
  )
RETURNING s.schedule_id, s.user_id, s.interval_days, s.next_run_date, s.measure_type, s.trigger_percentage, s.active;

INSERT INTO user_schedules
  (user_id, interval_days, next_run_date, measure_type, trigger_percentage, active)
VALUES
  ($1, $2, $3::date, $4, $5, TRUE)
RETURNING schedule_id, user_id, interval_days, next_run_date, measure_type, trigger_percentage, active;

UPDATE user_schedules s
SET active = true
WHERE s.schedule_id = $1
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "User_UC_Mappings" um
    JOIN feedback_config_rules f ON f.id = um.feedback_config_rule_id
    WHERE um.user_id = s.user_id
      AND um.active = true
      AND f.usecase_id = $2
  )
RETURNING s.schedule_id, s.user_id, s.interval_days, s.next_run_date, s.measure_type, s.trigger_percentage, s.active;

SELECT
  $1::int AS user_id,
  $2::int AS interval_days,
  $3::date AS next_run_date,
  $4::text AS measure_type,
  $5::numeric AS trigger_percentage,
  $6::int AS usecase_id,
  $7::text AS session_id;
